# AIFeed.run AI News

> The AI news that matters. Top AI stories, explained in 60 seconds. Sources linked on every story.

AIFeed.run is an AI-powered AI news brand. Stories are selected and written by AI systems from major outlets, then published on aifeed.run and across Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn. We do not claim human editors rewrite the news.

- Site: https://aifeed.run/
